source: 12-pose Unity preview-scene probe (GeometryProbe.cs) over SL15_Demo.unity and SL15_VideoPreview.unity at travel=-410, slew=90, luff in {-8, 0, 15}; wheel envelope measured from actual mesh vertices of the rig, not enlarged for reachability
